cohort: The study included 608 pregnant patients, comparing those during the COVID-19 lockdown period (March 15th to May 31st, 2020) with patients from the same period in the previous two years (2018 and 2019) in Picardy hospitals.
finding: The study found a significant reduction in hospitalizations for threatened preterm delivery, Premature Ruptures of Membranes, and the overall preterm delivery rate during the first COVID-19 lockdown period compared to previous years.
